text: 我是上海师范大学附属宝山经纬实验中学的谢意老师Today we are going to learn the discovery part, film styles around the world.In today's lesson, you will read a passage about different film styles of three countries.After reading, you will compare these film styles and try to explore more about other film styles.Are you ready for the class?Before we start, please get your student's book, worksheet and pen ready.First, let's take a look at some posters and review film types.They are musico, animation, action, sci-fi and adventure.Terrific!As you can see, there are different types of films.They are produced in different countries, America, India, China and so on.A country may produce films of a wide variety of types in a year.But does each country have its own film style?Are their film styles the same?Keep these questions in your mind and we are going to find the answers in today's class.Here are three pictures.Look at them and predict what the films are about.In my opinion, the second picture is probably about Indian films.Maybe the third picture is about Chinese films.But I have no idea who the two men are in the first picture.Is your prediction right?You can check it later.Before you read the passage, take a look at the title.You will read about several film styles around the world.Film style means the special way films look, tell stories and talk about important ideas.Film style makes each group of films different from the others.Now it's time to look at the title of this class.Now it's your turn to read the passage and complete the table in your worksheet.It's task one.What are the countries mentioned in the passage?What is the film style of each country?France is famous for romantic films.Indian films have singing and dancing performances.China is famous for kung fu films.Excellent.The passage introduces film styles of three countries.They are France,India and China.As you can see,their film styles are totally different.We're going to explore them one by one.Shall we take a look at French film style together?Read paragraph one again and think about the following questions.Question one.What are romantic films special for?I think romantic films are special for their plot.Romantic films are about love.Am I right?Are they just love stories?Not exactly.Let me show you some scenes in the French films.What do you think of them?Are they pleasant to enjoy?As you can see,they are romantic films.As you can see,French films often use different ways such as light,shadow,color to create enjoyable images.Now you may have a new understanding of romantic films.Think about the next question.Question two.How did French romantic films become famous worldwide?Read paragraph Fu master and a film star,Bruce Lee was also a Chinese American and a director.How did he successfully introduce Kung Fu films to the Western world?Since he was a Kung Fu master and a film star, he must combine traditional Chinese Kung Fu with films very well.Wonderful opinion.He was the first one to bring Chinese Kung Fu to the Western world.His experiences in both Hong Kong and United States made him understand different cultures.Up to now, his films are still the classics of Kung Fu films.I strongly recommend you to watch two films.Fist of Fury 金武門 and The Big Boss 唐山大雄These two films marked a turning point in Kung Fu films and had a great effect on popular cultures in the whole world.We have known three different film styles.Let us summarize ways to introduce film styles.When we introduce the film style of a country,we will mention its key feature,its representative and some detailed information.Read paragraph 1 again and mark them down.As for France,romantic films are its key feature.The Lumiere brothers are well-known representatives in French film history.The details are in 1895 and the words first to film.Take French film style as an example.Complete the table.It's task 2 in your worksheet.Now check your authors.Can you guess why the writer chooses to introduce French and Indian film styles?The Lumiere brothers,French inventors,show the world's first film.Bollywood produces thousands of films a year.Yeah,France is the birthplace of films and India has the biggest film industry in the world.That's probably why the writer wanted to show them to us.If you are interested in other film styles,you can also search for more information after class.In today's class,we have learned about three different film styles.Which film style do you like best?Do you know any other film style?Share your opinion with us.I like Kung Fu films best,because the stories are usually exciting.I can also learn a lot about Chinese traditions and values.In addition,I am greatly attracted by those great performers like Bruce Lee.I like Hollywood films,because they offer many kinds of themes and types.One can always enjoy new technology in Hollywood films.I love watching those special effects.Amy likes Kung Fu films,while Jason is interested in Hollywood films.You can find more about these film styles after class.In your opinion,why do films in different countries have different styles?Because different countries have different opinions on beauty,cultures,historical backgrounds,and social issues.They all make the film styles different from each other.Wonderful.There are many reasons why different countries have their own film styles.If you are interested,you can find more information online.In today's class,we have learned different film styles of France,India,and China.We have compared them and discussed the reasons behind these different styles.I hope you can discover more about other film styles after class.Today's homework.One,discover three more film styles around the world and complete the table.Two,make your discovery card about one film style and share it with your classmates next class.Class is over.See
